citation.source: Mertens (1874), 'Ein Beitrag zur analytischen Zahlentheorie', Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 78; standard modern form also in Montgomery–Vaughan, Multiplicative Number Theory I, Theorem 2.2
citation.theorem_number: Mertens' third theorem, harmonic prime-sum form
citation.verbatim: ∑_{p≤x} 1/p = log log x + B₁ + o(1) as x → ∞, where B₁ is the Mertens constant; equivalently ∑_{p≤x} 1/p − log log x → B₁.
